techniques.name: Water: Water Bullet
techniques.mechanic: A fast ball of water (2 blocks a tick, 18 range): soaked; puts out burning
techniques.counters: earth jutsu (earth beats water), stay away from water (water jutsu cost more far from it)

techniques.name: Water: Wild Water Wave
techniques.mechanic: Spit a pushing wave (12-block cone): knockback 4, soaked, puts out fire
techniques.counters: earth jutsu (earth beats water), stay away from water (water jutsu cost more far from it)

techniques.name: Water: Water Wall
techniques.mechanic: A spinning wall of water around you (radius 3) for 60 ticks: blocks fire and thrown weapons
techniques.counters: earth breaks it; wait it out

techniques.name: Water: Hiding Mist
techniques.mechanic: A thick mist (radius 12) for 400 ticks: everyone without sensing is smoked; your silent steps go unheard
techniques.counters: wind blows it away; sensing; Byakugan

techniques.name: Water: Water Prison
techniques.mechanic: Trap a target within 3 blocks in a sphere of water: bound and cannot weave; you must keep a hand inside (you cannot move or attack)
techniques.counters: an ally hits the caster; lightning through the water hurts the prisoner

techniques.name: Water: Water Clone
techniques.mechanic: A clone of water with your taijutsu (30% of your health) near water; one far from water costs double
techniques.counters: earth jutsu (earth beats water), stay away from water (water jutsu cost more far from it)

techniques.name: Water: Water Dragon
techniques.mechanic: A dragon of water crashes onto a 3-block area (homing 0.2); far from water it costs 50% more
techniques.counters: earth jutsu (earth beats water), stay away from water (water jutsu cost more far from it)

techniques.name: Water: Great Waterfall
techniques.mechanic: A wall of water crashing outward (radius 10 around a point ahead), carrying enemies 8 blocks
techniques.counters: earth jutsu (earth beats water), stay away from water (water jutsu cost more far from it)

techniques.name: Water: Shark Bomb
techniques.mechanic: A shark of water that hunts its target and grows by eating enemy chakra jutsu it meets
techniques.counters: earth jutsu (earth beats water), stay away from water (water jutsu cost more far from it)

techniques.name: Water: Thousand Feeding Sharks
techniques.mechanic: A thousand sharks rise from a water surface (radius 14 around you; needs water within 8 blocks or a great waterfall first)
techniques.counters: earth jutsu (earth beats water), stay away from water (water jutsu cost more far from it)
